failure_reason: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl with a real browser UA) and tier (b) headless Playwright/Chromium both received the Imperva/Incapsula 'Pardon Our Interruption' anti-bot interstitial on the homepage (empty JS shell, no nav/product data reachable) - blocked at both tiers. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome per the brief (robots.txt names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow, only crawler-targeted refine=/filter=/sort= disallows). The connected Chrome session loaded the live SPA successfully and the mega-menu plus roughly 19 category listing pages (Bedroom, Kids Bedding, Home Decor) were read for their rendered 'N Results' counters. Partway through, davidjones.com began serving an Imperva CAPTCHA interstitial ('Just a quick check... complete the following security verification') on further navigations in the tab, blocking quantity capture for the remaining Kids Bedding leaves, Dining/Table Linen, Bathroom (Towels/Bath Mats/Bathrobes/Accessories/Laundry), Home Decor Rugs (indoor+outdoor), and any Kitchen/Pantry or site-wide Storage categories beyond Bedroom Storage. Per the hard rule to stop on first block per tier and not chase it via another route, no further requests were sent to the host after the CAPTCHA appeared.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) curl/requests-style fetch of https://www.davidjones.com/ returned an Imperva/Incapsula 'Pardon Our Interruption' page (6KB empty shell, meta robots noindex) - blocked. tier (b) Playwright headless chromium (own launch, real Chrome UA, networkidle wait) hit the identical Imperva interstitial - blocked. tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (own tab in the shared connected browser) reached the real rendered site and worked until the CAPTCHA wall described in failure_reason appeared; final status is partial, not fully blocked, because a meaningful subset of the tree was captured with verified exact quantities before the wall. TREE: built from the 'Home & Food' top-nav mega-menu (hover-expanded via accessibility tree read, real hrefs captured for every menu item: Bedroom, Kitchen Appliances, Kitchen, Dining, Bathroom & Laundry, Home Decor, Personal Care/Home Appliances, Luggage & Travel, Food & Liquor, Books & Stationery, Audio & Tech, Outdoor & BBQ, Designer). Where a menu leaf (e.g. Bed Linen, Kids Bedding) itself carried a 'Category' refinement strip, the strip's chips were inspected via DOM query and confirmed to be real distinct href-bearing subcategory URLs (not ?refine= query-string filters, which robots.txt disallows for crawlers) - those deeper leaves were recorded instead of the parent per textile.md section 25 / storage.md section 34 (parent-URL-not-recorded-when-subcategories-exist rule). Breadcrumb was checked against the requested slug on every leaf to guard against the 'bad slug silently serves a plausible wrong number' failure mode; all recorded leaves matched. QTY: read the rendered '<N> Results' counter via a JS body-text regex match on each leaf's own listing page (e.g. '2,460 Results', '914 Results') - this is the site's own displayed total, not an API/products_count field. EXCLUDED (present in the mega-menu but out of scope): all Home Decor purely-decorative leaves (Photo Frames & Albums, Vases, Decorative Bowls & Trays, Sculptures & Decorative Objects, Home Fragrance, Lamps & Lighting, Mirrors & Wall Art, Furniture, Clocks & Alarms, Candle Holders, Plants & Planters) - decorative/lighting/furniture/wall-decor boundary; all Dining tableware (Dinnerware, Glassware, Cups & Mugs, Cutlery, Serveware, Barware) - Kitchen & Dining boundary, not textile/storage; Beds & Mattresses - Furniture; Electric Blankets - a heated appliance (appliances/home/electric-blankets), not a plain textile product; every '<X> Designer' page (Designer Bedroom/Dining/Kitchen/Bathroom/Decor) - these are cross-category designer-brand collection pages, not a single valid subcategory, excluded under the View All/Collections rule; Kitchen Appliances, Personal Care, Audio & Tech, Books & Stationery, Games & Puzzles, Arts & Crafts, Luggage & Travel, Food & Liquor - unrelated departments; Bathroom Accessories and Laundry menu items were left unclassified (neither array) rather than guessed, because their sub-contents (possibly a mix of storage baskets/hampers, non-textile accessories, or appliances) could not be inspected before the CAPTCHA block. UNRESOLVED / MANUAL REVIEW (real site URLs confirmed to exist via the mega-menu or a category's own facet strip, but the 'N Results' counter could not be captured before the block, so qty is null rather than fabricated): Kids Quilts, Kids Pillows, Kids Toppers & Protectors, Baby Blankets (Textile, under Kids Bedding); Table Linen (Textile, Dining); Towels, Bath Mats, Bathrobes (Textile, Bathroom & Laundry); Outdoor Rugs (Textile, Outdoor & BBQ); Bathroom Storage, Kitchen/Pantry Storage, Office Storage and any other site-wide Storage nodes were not reached at all before the block and are omitted rather than guessed. 'Pillows' and 'Kids Pillows' (filled sleep-pillow inserts, not pillowcases) were classified Textile at MEDIUM confidence per textile.md section 35 - they sit directly in the site's own Bedding/Manchester navigation alongside Quilts and Bed Linen, but are not explicitly named in the textile.md include list (which names Pillowcases/Pillow Shams, not plain sleep pillows).
